items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: Your grandmother was Jefferson, Rose Jefferson.

ctx.x: I think it was Jefferson, Theresa Jefferson.
Your grandmother was Jefferson, Rose Jefferson. And so, Uncle Hendry anyway, was that New Iberia too?

Yeah he came in New Iberia at that time. Did he play music? Well there was three of them. Let's see the other ones, they played at little night clubs, you know, nice spots around New Iberia. They had a little, just a trio. And then after that, the Bunk would come home, you know. And that's where he lost his teeth completely one night.
